mapper.insert: INSERT INTO background_check (employee_id, external_check_id, status, requested_at, triggered_by_account_id) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{externalCheckId}, #{status}, #{requestedAt}, #{triggeredByAccountId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM background_check WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY requested_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM background_check WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.update: UPDATE background_check SET status = #{status}, criminal_record = #{criminalRecord, typeHandler=com.bitcomputer.portal.crypto.EncryptedStringTypeHandler}, education_verified = #{educationVerified, typeHandler=com.bitcomputer.portal.crypto.EncryptedStringTypeHandler}, employment_verified = #{employmentVerified, typeHandler=com.bitcomputer.portal.crypto.EncryptedStringTypeHandler}, credit_score = #{creditScore, typeHandler=com.bitcomputer.portal.crypto.EncryptedStringTypeHandler}, completed_at = #{completedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE background_check SET status = 'ERROR', error_message = #{errorMessage} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM background_check WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at <= #{cutoff} AND masked_at IS NULL
